mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the temperature and door-opening logs was most worthwhile: it gave the spikes a plausible explanation while making clear that air readings do not establish every stored object's temperature.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the filter and fan felt fairly predictable; the separate steps made the repair clear but offered little meaningful choice.

surprise.text: The renewal warning appeared just as the cooling service record was verified, showing that a successful repair did not settle the supply issue.

arbitrary.text: Combining the forecast with the monitored cooler was a guess based on the remaining relevant pieces; I did not know exactly how the comparison would work.

continue.text: Yes. The careful distinction between evidence and uncertainty interested me, and I would like to see how the supply warning is addressed.
